prompt: A boutique buys 200 identical scarves for $15 each. They initially sell 60% of the scarves at a 50% markup from their cost price. Later, they offer a discount on the remaining scarves. Of these remaining scarves, 75% are sold at a 20% discount off the initial (marked-up) selling price. The rest are donated. What is the boutique's total net profit from the scarf sales?
